nodes.description: Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) that whitelists owner/UNI pair/tradeAddress/canSale senders and otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) moving balances with unchecked subtraction/addition after ensure().
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view condition(address _from, uint _value) enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale sale limits.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) performing an owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address.
Public _mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) minting supply to spender and enabling canSale, owner/backdoor-address guarded.
Public owner-only init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) setting sale limits.
Public payable owner-only batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) airdropping tokens with unchecked arithmetic.
Public owner-only setTradeAddress(address addr) setting the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) computing the Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender and initial balances/allowances.
Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf holding token balances.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] storing ERC20 approvals.
Private address owner; superuser of privileged functions.
Private mapping(address => uint256) _onSaleNum counting sales per address.
Private mapping(address => bool) canSale whitelist set by _mints.
Private uint256 _minSale minimum sale value limit.
Private uint256 _maxSale maximum sale value limit.
Private uint256 _saleNum per-address sale count limit.
address tradeAddress whitelisted trading address.
Public uint totalSupply of the token.
Public string name.
Public string symbol.
Public constant uint decimals = 18.
Constant address UNI (0x7a25...488D) used in whitelist checks.
msg.sender, user-controlled caller address used for authorization and allowance checks.
delegatecall in delegate(address a, bytes b) executes arbitrary external bytecode in the contract storage context.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total (Solidity 0.5 no SafeMath).
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
Unchecked arithmetic in _mints: balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) without SafeMath.

Parameter _value of condition (amount being checked).

Loop index i in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer() passes msg.sender as the source address into transferFrom.
transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom().
transferFrom() uses msg.sender for the allowance[_from][msg.sender] check and decrement.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from the caller.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the Uniswap pair address.
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints() is guarded by require(msg.sender==owner || msg.sender==hardcoded backdoor address).
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor() sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sale.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sale.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale limit.
ensure() whitelists _from/_to equal to owner.
ensure() bypasses condition() when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() whitelists _from equal to tradeAddress.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
batchSend() reads and mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to].
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the minted amount.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a whitelist bypass in transferFrom.
constructor() assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor() assigns balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor() sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
constructor() sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor() sets name.
constructor() sets symbol.
delegate() reaches the raw delegatecall unsafe operation with user-supplied address and calldata.
batchSend() values flow into unchecked multiplication/subtraction enabling overflow/underflow.
transferFrom() values flow into unchecked allowance/balance subtraction.
_mints() addedValue flows into unchecked multiplication by 10**decimals.
